name: admiration
quote: I like the way she brushed off that insult.
description: Judgment that a person or creation process shows unusual quality or skill. Admiration is about the person or process that created something that you appreciate.
perceptions: You appreciate that someone or something has unusually good qualities.
You recognize that displaying these characteristics doesn't happen automatically.

variations.name: admiration of a product
variations.description: Recognizing a thing or idea as having an uncommon special formulation. The product may be physical like a shoe or purely mental like a mathematical equation. You might not know the person or group behind the object, but you can still admire the fact it took some level of genius to create it.

variations.name: inspirational admiration
variations.description: Admiring traits that we would like to exhibit ourselves.
perceptions: You appreciate that someone or something has unusually good qualities.
You would like to have some of those good qualities yourself.
results: desire to learn how to emulate the skill

guidance.description: 8 Tips for Learning a New Skill

variations.name: admiration of the unusual
variations.description: A sense that another person is different from others in a good or interesting way. You may not want to possess that trait yourself, but you can appreciate its existence.
